identityIntro: Let's start with the basics. This only takes a moment.
preferredLanguageLabel: Which language do you want the app in?
documentationIntro: If you have an identity document, add it here. If you don't have one, that's fine: choose "I don't have one" and continue.
documentReassurance: Only the Ramassà team can see this, and it is stored encrypted.
logisticsIntro: These details help us reach you and prepare your kit.
termsIntro: One last thing: read and accept how we handle your data.
termsBody: Ramassà keeps your data to run the program's sports and community activity: training, events, kit, and staying in touch with you. Sensitive data (document, phone, address) is stored encrypted and only the Ramassà team can see it. We never share your data with anyone outside the program or use it for advertising. You can ask to see, correct or delete it at any time by talking to the team.
termsAcceptLabel: I have read and accept the terms
mediaConsentLabel: I'm happy to appear in community photos and stories (optional)
mediaConsentHint: You can change this any time from your profile.
errorTooYoung: You need to be 16 or older. If you are younger, talk to the Ramassà team.
errorNieFormat: A NIE is one letter, seven digits and one letter. For example: X1234567L.
errorPhoneFormat: Write the phone with its prefix, for example +34 600 111 222.
errorPostalFormat: A postal code is five digits.
errorDependentsRange: Tell us how many, between 1 and 15.
completionFailed: We could not save your details. Please try again.
